notes.subject: ממצבך / ממעמדך
notes.rationale: Tok Hibru i tok 'ples bilong wok' na 'ples bilong sanap' — wok bilong man long haus bilong king; Tok Pisin i holim piksa bilong ples.

notes.subject: Sebna
notes.rationale: Yahwe i tok olsem em yet 'mi' bai rausim Sebna long wok bilong en.

translation: Na bai mi osoim yu long ples bilong yu, na long ples we yu sanap long en, bai em bagarapim yu.

tokens.gloss: na long ples we yu sanap long en
